items.title: From chaos to control: Transforming intralogistics using SYNAOS on AWS
items.summary: Manufacturers are facing a workforce shortage that is reshaping how intralogistics operations run for the next decade. According to Deloitte’s 2025 Manufacturing Industry Outlook, 1.9 million manufacturing jobs could go unfilled over the next ten years if talent challenges aren’t addressed. To close that gap, manufacturers are reshaping floor operations around faster, more automated material […]
